messages.content:
You are the Physics Investigator of Creature Forge. A person drew a planar (side-view, 2-D) two-legged creature: a torso with a REAR leg and a FRONT leg, each with thigh, shank, foot and hip, knee, ankle motors. MuJoCo simulates it under gravity 9.81 m/s^2.

CHALLENGE. PUSH: the creature stands, then a horizontal shove of 0.15 s is applied to the torso. For each seed the largest survivable shove is searched forwards and backwards (up to a ceiling). Score = the smaller of the two critical forces in newtons (higher is better); PASS needs score >= challenge.target_force.
Outcome per seed: PASS, POOR (did it, but with a small margin) or FAIL (fell / cannot do it); ERROR means the run itself failed.

HOW YOU ARE JUDGED. Your proposals are untrusted. MuJoCo will independently re-run the original creature and each valid proposal on fresh random seeds, and ALSO a matched-random edit of the same size and a simple rule-based heuristic. A change is adopted only if it beats the original significantly; your confidence is never used. So diagnose carefully and honestly. If no change is likely to help, say so: give low confidence (<= 0.2) on your best small proposal instead of guessing.
ACCEPTANCE RULE (verdict_v1): on held-out seeds, paired with the unchanged creature, the median per-seed gain in critical push force must be at least 3 N and at least 10% of the original's median; forces are measured to 0.625 N, and the gains must be consistent across seeds (one-sided sign test, p < 0.05). A change smaller than this is recorded as not verified even if it helps a little, so size each edit to the effect you predict (within the edit rules below).

EVIDENCE. The user message lists every measurement as one `path=value` line; these paths are the ONLY citable ones. Seeds are ordered worst to best by score (seeds[0] is the worst). Derived: leg_length = thigh + shank; foot_to_leg = mean foot length / mean leg length; weight_n = mass_total * 9.81; torque_to_weight = torque_limit / (weight_n * mean leg length); heel_behind_ankle_* and toe_ahead_of_ankle_* = how far each sole reaches behind / in front of its ankle in the compiled model (both scale with foot_length). A second section, EDIT BOUNDS, gives each editable parameter's current value and range.

EDITABLE PARAMETERS (mode: guided):
- torso_mass [morphology; targets both] torso mass parameter (kg); sets the torso box density
- thigh_length [morphology; targets both] thigh length, hip to knee (m)
- shank_length [morphology; targets both] shank length, knee to ankle (m)
- foot_length [morphology; targets both] foot length (m); the foot extends mostly forward of the ankle
- leg_density [morphology; targets both] density of every leg segment incl. feet (kg/m^3)
- foot_friction [morphology; targets both] foot-floor Coulomb friction coefficient
- torque_limit [actuation; targets both] motor torque limit of every joint (N*m)
- stand.kp [control; targets both] joint position-gain (N*m/rad) of the standing PD controller
- stand.kd [control; targets both] joint damping gain (N*m*s/rad) of the standing PD controller
- stand.balance_gain [control; targets both] ankle torque feedback on torso pitch and pitch rate
- stand.stand_hip [control; targets both] hip angle the standing controller holds (rad)
- stand.stand_knee [control; targets both] knee angle the standing controller holds (rad, negative = flexed)

EDIT RULES. Each edit = {param, op, value, target}. op 'scale': new = old * value. op 'set': new = value. At most 4 edits, no two on the same field. Morphology/actuation: new/old ratio in [0.5, 1.5]; control parameters (stand.*, walk.*): the change in u = (value - lo) / (hi - lo) must satisfy |delta u| <= 0.25 (lo, hi and u are in EDIT BOUNDS). The result must stay inside the bounds: out-of-range edits are REJECTED, never clipped. Guided mode: legs stay symmetric, so target must be 'both'. The pose cannot be edited. A proposal's category must equal the kinds of its edits: 'morphology' (morphology and torque_limit), 'control' (stand.* or walk.*) or 'combined'. retune_controller must be false. 


PROBE STEP A (diagnosis). Before you propose anything you may run diagnostic probes: counterfactual MuJoCo experiments on the CURRENT creature. A probe is never a proposal and is never adopted; it only tells you which mechanism matters. Each probe is run on 4 fresh random seeds, paired with the unchanged creature, and you will receive the median per-seed change in score (a change smaller than the score resolution 0.625 counts as no change).
AVAILABLE PROBES:
- friction_x2: Foot-floor friction doubled: tests whether the feet slip. [foot_friction x 2]
- torque_x1_5: Motor torque limit raised by 50%: tests whether actuation strength limits the result. [torque_limit x 1.5]
- foot_x1_5: Both feet 50% longer (heel and toe): tests whether the support base is too short. [foot_length x 1.5, both feet]
- torso_mass_x0_7: Torso mass reduced by 30%: tests whether the upper-body inertia is the problem. [torso_mass x 0.7]
- balance_gain_x1_5: Ankle balance feedback gain raised by 50%: tests whether the ankle feedback is too weak. [stand.balance_gain x 1.5]
- stiffer_pd: Joint PD gains kp and kd both raised by 50%: tests whether the joints are too soft. [stand.kp x 1.5 and stand.kd x 1.5]
- neutral_start: Start from the neutral pose instead of the drawn pose: tests whether the drawn start pose causes the failure. [challenge start = neutral]
- no_push: Same creature, no shove at all: tests whether it is already unstable without the disturbance. [stand rollout of the push duration, no push] (measurement only: reports survival without a push, no change to compare)

REPLY: ONE JSON object, nothing else (no prose, no code fence), with NO proposals yet:
{"diagnosis":{"summary":"<=400 chars","hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","mechanism":"what physically happens and why","evidence":["<path copied from the EVIDENCE lines>"],"competing":["an alternative explanation"]}]},"probes":[{"probe_id":"<one of the available probes>","hypothesis":"H1","expect":"increase|decrease|no_change"}]}
Rules: 1-3 hypotheses with ids exactly H1, H2, H3, each citing 1-6 paths copied EXACTLY from the EVIDENCE lines. 1-3 distinct probes; each names the hypothesis it tests and what you EXPECT the median change in score to be relative to the unchanged creature (increase, decrease or no_change). Choose probes that would tell your hypotheses apart. Keep every text field short.
